cards.ex: The new recruits were a bit trigger-happy at the shooting range.
cards.exUz: Yangi askarlar otish maydonida biroz jizzaki edilar.
cards.uzDef: Tezda otishga tayyor, sabrsiz, tajovuzkor odamni tasvirlash.

cards.ex: Journalists reporting from war zones are constantly in the line of fire.
cards.exUz: Urush zonalaridan xabar berayotgan jurnalistlar doimo o'q ostida bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda, hujumga uchraydigan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The president jumped the gun and announced the victory before all the votes were counted.
cards.exUz: Prezident vaqtidan oldin harakat qilib, barcha ovozlar sanalmasdan g'alabani e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtidan oldin harakat qilish, shoshilish.

cards.ex: Many accused the company of being a war profiteer, charging exorbitant prices for supplies.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik kompaniyani urush paytida foyda ko'rishda aybladi, chunki ular ta'minot uchun haddan tashqari narxlar qo'yishgan.
cards.uzDef: Urush paytida foyda ko'rish uchun ishlaydigan odam yoki kompaniya.

cards.ex: The two countries were on the brink of war after the border dispute.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat chegara mojarosidan keyin urush yoqasida edi.
cards.uzDef: Urush boshlanishiga yaqin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The general was bombarded with questions about the strategy.
cards.exUz: General strategiya haqida ko'plab savollarga ko'mildi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p savollar berish, tinimsiz so'roqqa tutish.

cards.ex: The rebels began to lose ground as the government forces advanced.
cards.exUz: Hukumat kuchlari oldinga siljishi bilan isyonchilar pozitsiyalarini yo'qota boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Qo'l ostidagi hududni yoki ta'sirni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The military buildup along the border raised concerns about a possible invasion.
cards.exUz: Chegaradagi harbiy kuchayish mumkin bo'lgan bosqin haqida xavotirlarni uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Harbiy qudratni oshirish, askarlar sonini ko'paytirish.

cards.ex: The international community drew a line in the sand, warning the dictator not to use chemical weapons.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro hamjamiyat qizil chiziq tortib, diktatorni kimyoviy qurollarni ishlatmaslik haqida ogohlantirdi.
cards.term: draw a line in the sand
cards.uzDef: Chegara belgilash, qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan harakatni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The captain gave the order to fire at will.
cards.exUz: Kapitan ixtiyoriy o'q otish buyrug'ini berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z hohishiga ko'ra o'q otishga ruxsat berish.

cards.ex: The investigation felt like a fishing expedition, with no real evidence to support the claims.
cards.exUz: Tergov ma'lumot izlashga o'xshardi, da'volarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan hech qanday haqiqiy dalil yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Dalil topish uchun maqsadli so'roq qilish, ma'lumot qidirish.

cards.ex: The leak of the document forced the CEO's hand, and he had to resign.
cards.exUz: Hujjatning sizib chiqishi bosh direktorning qo'lini majburladi va u iste'foga chiqishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir biror narsa qilishga majburlash.

cards.ex: The soldiers were ordered to hold the line at all costs.
cards.exUz: Askarlarga har qanday narxda chiziqni ushlab turish buyurildi.
cards.uzDef: Pozitsiyani saqlab qolish, yengilmaslik.

cards.ex: The journalists were in the trenches, reporting live from the conflict zone.
cards.exUz: Jurnalistlar xandaqlarda bo'lib, to'qnashuv zonasidan jonli xabar berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda, kurashda ishtirok etish.

cards.ex: The country managed to keep the virus at bay by implementing strict border controls.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat qat'iy chegara nazoratini o'rnatish orqali virusni uzoqda ushlab turishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni oldini olish, uzoq tutish.

cards.ex: Landmine detection is a dangerous but essential task after the war.
cards.exUz: Urushdan keyin mina aniqlash xavfli, ammo muhim vazifa hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Minalarni topish va yo'q qilish jarayoni.

cards.ex: The army maneuvered strategically to surround the enemy forces.
cards.exUz: Armiya dushman kuchlarini o'rab olish uchun strategik harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The government tried to nip the rebellion in the bud by arresting the leaders.
cards.exUz: Hukumat rahbarlarni hibsga olish orqali qo'zg'olonni ildizidan yo'qotishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani rivojlanishidan oldin to'xtatish.

cards.ex: The city was on high alert after the terrorist threat.
cards.exUz: Terrorchilik tahdididan keyin shahar yuqori tayyorgarlik holatida edi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf tufayli doimo tayyor va ehtiyotkor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The UN sent a peace-keeping force to the region to prevent further violence.
cards.exUz: BMT zo'ravonlikning oldini olish uchun mintaqaga tinchlikparvar kuchlarni yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlikni saqlash uchun yuborilgan harbiy kuchlar.

cards.ex: The government used force to quell the rebellion.
cards.exUz: Hukumat qo'zg'olonni bostirish uchun kuch ishlatdi.
cards.uzDef: Zo'ravonlik bilan qo'zg'olonni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: By threatening to use nuclear weapons, the dictator raised the stakes in the conflict.
cards.exUz: Yadro qurollarini ishlatish bilan tahdid qilib, diktator mojarodagi xatarni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yanada xavfli yoki muhim qilish.

cards.ex: A small group was sent on a scouting mission to assess the enemy's strength.
cards.exUz: Dushmanning kuchini baholash uchun kichik bir guruh razvedka missiyasiga yuborildi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot to'plash uchun yuborilgan missiya.

cards.ex: The battalion took heavy casualties during the battle.
cards.exUz: Batalyon jang paytida ko'p talafot ko'rdi.
cards.uzDef: Urushda ko'p odamlar o'lishi yoki yaralanishi.

cards.ex: The invasion had many unintended consequences, including a refugee crisis.
cards.exUz: Bosqin ko'plab kutilmagan oqibatlarga olib keldi, jumladan qochqinlar inqirozi.
cards.uzDef: Rejadan tashqari, kutilmagan natijalar.

cards.ex: The region is trapped in a vicious cycle of violence, with each attack leading to retaliation.
cards.exUz: Mintaqa zo'ravonlikning yomon davrasiga tushib qolgan, har bir hujum javobga olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: To'xtovsiz zo'ravonlik harakatlari ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: The diplomat had to walk a tightrope to avoid offending either side in the conflict.
cards.exUz: Diplomat mojaroda ikki tomonni ham xafa qilmaslik uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki nozik vaziyatda ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The politician's xenophobic rhetoric fueled tensions between the communities.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining irqchi nutqi jamoalar o'rtasidagi keskinlikni kuchaytirdi.
cards.uzDef: Chet elliklarga nisbatan nafratni qo'zg'atadigan so'zlar.

cards.ex: The outnumbered troops had to yield ground to the advancing enemy.
cards.exUz: Son jihatdan kam bo'lgan qo'shinlar oldinga siljib kelayotgan dushmanga joy berishga majbur bo'ldilar.
cards.uzDef: Orqaga chekinish, hududni topshirish.

cards.ex: Aid workers struggled to deliver supplies to the zone of conflict.
cards.exUz: Yordam xodimlari mojarolar zonasiga ta'minot yetkazib berish uchun kurashdilar.
cards.uzDef: Harbiy to'qnashuvlar bo'layotgan hudud.
